episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Noh In-ji receives her next field wife assignment. Han Jeong-won struggles with his separation from ex-wife Lee Seo-yeon and an impending second marriage.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Five years ago, after her fiancé vanishes, In-ji has a fateful meeting. In the present, she learns more about her new husband and his ex-wife.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Jeong-won slowly warms up to his new wife. Sensing a change, Lee Seo-yeon tries to make her ex crack. Meanwhile, someone from In-ji's past resurfaces.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As In-ji creates a homey life and instills peace around Jeong-won, he grapples with his growing desire for her. Seo-yeon can't handle losing control.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Jeong-won learns about Eom Tae-seong and offers help, but In-ji rebuffs him. Seo-yeon gets a grim warning. Later, the wife and ex-wife clash at a funeral.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Seo-yeon demands an end to their tangled relationship, and In-ji boldly confronts her. Meanwhile, a mysterious figure lurks near Seo Do-ha's apartment.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Shocked by the bloody corridor, In-ji steps into Do-ha's apartment with trepidation. Who or what will she find, and will she finally get closure?

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: After learning of Seo-yeon's betrayal, Jeong-won cuts their toxic ties. In-ji decides to end everything and invites Tae-seong for a decisive moment.
